title: feat(spec): requires accepts audit-compliance and access-policy-console, two cloud-loader capability tokens beside governance

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBX5AKQ7ZjuoowRzDFy9HZig)_

Fixes #32011

Clause-②: yes (widening: two new accepted `requires` tokens)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #32041 — skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md (L318-320, the "Enterprise / cloud" bullet, names `ai-seat` and `governance` as the tokens only cloud's objectos-runtime resolves and now omits `audit-compliance` and `access-policy-console`; `skills/**` is outside this card). No `content/docs/**` sentence lists the cloud-loader tokens (`git grep -n -e ai-seat -e governance -- skills content/docs ':!content/docs/releases'` at 36864c49: 1 hit, that SKILL.md line; control `hierarchy-security`: 6 hits in 4 files)
Prior rulings read: platform_capability_tokens,governance,audit-compliance,access-policy-console → 9 hits; ADR-0027 Decision §14, ADR-0033 Decision §10, ADR-0076 D3, ADR-0076 D4/D5/D6/D8, ADR-0076 D8, ADR-0086 D6, ADR-0086 D7, ADR-0104 D3; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack. Every hit is on the word "governance" in another sense (authoring governance, authz governance); none rules on the capability vocabulary. ADR-0033 §6 puts audit and publish governance in the paid tier, which agrees with a cloud-only token.
Carried: objectstack-ai/cloud#4218 (repo:cloud#1, `Notify: serial · #4218 behind #32011`, 6755116793): cloud's loader adds the two `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS` entries after a pin carries this, flipping the hosted catalog column for audit compliance (cloud#3665) and the access-policy console (cloud#3668). Until then `defineStack` accepts both tokens and no runtime provides them; the open edition's `os build` preflight reports them unavailable.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`requires` 新接受两个能力 token：`audit-compliance` 和 `access-policy-console`，与 `governance` 同组（只由云端 objectos-runtime 加载器提供）；provider 表各加一行，`package: null`、`edition: 'cloud'`，与 `governance` 同形。
- 为什么改：云端有这两项按环境开通的能力，没有 token 就无法在 stack 里声明，云端只能把它们标成不可用。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽；原来能过的照旧能过，近似拼写（`audit_compliance`、`access-policy`）照旧拒收。本仓不装任何包，开源版 `os build` 对这两个 token 的处理与 `governance` 完全一致（判为仅云端可用并失败）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts`（token 组与两行 provider）；`packages/spec/src/stack-requires.test.ts` 新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/stack-requires.test.ts src/kernel/platform-capabilities.test.ts`，预期 2 个文件全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS`** (`packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts`): `audit-compliance` and `access-policy-console` join the enterprise / cloud-runtime group after `governance`. The group comment now names all four cloud-loader tokens (`ai-seat`, `governance`, `audit-compliance`, `access-policy-console`) and says this repository installs nothing for them. The `PlatformCapabilityProvider.package` docblock that lists the `null`-package tokens names the two new ones too.
- **`PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS`**: `'audit-compliance': { package: null, edition: 'cloud', note: 'cloud audit-compliance tier' }` and `'access-policy-console': { package: null, edition: 'cloud', note: 'cloud access-policy console' }`. No package name is invented: cloud's loader resolves both, and nothing here could install one.
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/spec` minor, carrying the declaration lines above.

What does not move: `defineStack`'s refusal path (an unknown token still gets `STACK_CAPABILITY_UNKNOWN`, 422), the `os build` / `os validate` preflight code (it reads the provider table, so both tokens classify `unavailable` exactly as `governance` does), `objectstack serve` (a known token with no core `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS` row is skipped quietly, as for `ai-seat` / `governance`), and the CLI vocabulary-drift test, which does not enumerate the cloud-only set and needed no edit.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/stack-requires.test.ts`, new top-level describe: `defineStack` accepts `requires: ['audit-compliance']` and `['access-policy-console']` and passes each through untouched, and accepts all four cloud-loader tokens together. The near misses `audit_compliance`, `auditCompliance`, `access-policy` and `access_policy_console` are each refused with the ADR-0112 envelope: `code` `STACK_CAPABILITY_UNKNOWN`, `status` 422, one `issues` entry naming the token.
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.test.ts`, new top-level describe: the `package: null` rows are exactly `ai-seat`, `governance`, `audit-compliance`, `access-policy-console`; each of the four is in the vocabulary with `edition: 'cloud'`, `package: null` and a note; both new tokens classify `unavailable` even when every package resolves; the near-miss spellings are not in the vocabulary.

- CLI, after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli^...' build`: `vitest run test/serve-capability-vocabulary.test.ts test/capability-preflight.test.ts`: Test Files 2 passed, Tests 38 passed.
- Ablation, once, on `src` (both spec test files import `src`, no `dist` hop): `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` removed the `'audit-compliance'` entry from `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS` (anchor 1 → 0, blob 87b422bf → 18b32c27). The two edited files went red: Tests 4 failed, 75 passed (79): the provider-map 1:1 pin, the cloud-row pin for `audit-compliance`, and both `defineStack` acceptance pins (refused with "requires: 'audit-compliance' is not a known platform capability"). Restore: blob back to 87b422bf, equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. A first attempt used a replacement that was a substring of the anchor; the tool refused it before any test ran, so that run measured nothing.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Two comments outside this card's file surface still name only the older cloud tokens as examples: `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts:5370` ("`ai-seat`/`governance` by cloud's objectos-runtime — stay quiet for those") and the `validateKnownCapabilities` docblock in `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts:6227` ("(`hierarchy-security` / `ai-seat` / `governance`)"). Both describe behaviour that holds for the new tokens too; neither is a defect. Noted, not filed.
- PR body: the seat signature line is first and the project attribution block follows it, the shape this project's card PRs use.
